message.cutecritters.welcome: Cute Critters+: your animal friends are happy to see you!
message.cutecritters.whisper.5: It is closer than you think.
message.cutecritters.whisper.7: You have been here too long.
message.cutecritters.high.0: So warm... everything is so bright.
message.cutecritters.high.1: The colours are singing. One more?
message.cutecritters.truth: THIS IS NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
message.cutecritters.comedown: It's cold now. You want more.
advancement.cutecritters.root.title: First Bite
advancement.cutecritters.root.desc: Try the cookie. It's so warm.
advancement.cutecritters.first_note.desc: Find a note. Someone wanted it to be read.
note.cutecritters.0.title: Baker's diary, day 1
note.cutecritters.0.text: The Keeper baked cookies for the whole valley again. She says it is so nobody feels lonely. I like how they smell.
note.cutecritters.1.title: Baker's diary, day 19
note.cutecritters.1.text: The harvest did not grow. The Keeper does not sleep. She whispers to the pets: no one will leave, no one will leave.
note.cutecritters.2.title: Letter to my sister
note.cutecritters.2.text: Don't come. Everyone here has become so kind. Too kind. I stopped understanding where I end.
note.cutecritters.3.title: Recipe (worn out part)
note.cutecritters.3.text: Wheat, cocoa, sugar. And the thing that must not be named. The last ingredient must be given willingly.
note.cutecritters.4.title: Scribble on the altar wall
note.cutecritters.4.text: Whoever stays by choice will never be lonely again. Whoever leaves leaves emptiness behind. Which is heavier?
note.cutecritters.5.title: Last entry
note.cutecritters.5.text: She is not evil. She just forgot why she began. If someone reminds her of her recipe... maybe she will let go.
message.cutecritters.comedown.hard: Everything went out. But you can still hear the laughter.
advancement.cutecritters.first_friend.de: Tame a critter with a cookie. It will never leave you.
message.cutecritters.ask.5: Name the friend who is near you.
message.cutecritters.reply.0.no: You are lying. I hear only you.
message.cutecritters.reply.3: Liar. I can hear your heart.
message.cutecritters.reply.5: He will hear it soon too.
note.cutecritters.6.title: Library catalogue
note.cutecritters.6.text: Every book of the valley was copied, then burned. One is left: 'The Recipe'. Nobody checked it out. But the shelf is empty and the dust on it is fresh.
note.cutecritters.7.title: The sexton's diary
note.cutecritters.7.text: I do not dig the new graves. In the morning the earth is already turned, and there is a cookie in the hole. I do not eat it. I know what it is made of. Another one was dug today. I do not know whose.
note.cutecritters.8.title: A child's drawing
note.cutecritters.8.text: Mum has not answered for three days. Auntie says Mum became kinder. I drew Auntie with very big arms so she can hug everyone at once.
note.cutecritters.9.title: Unsigned
note.cutecritters.9.text: If you are reading this, you are already standing where I stood. Do not look back. She is learning to be quiet. Soon you will hear your own footsteps behind you. You will like them.
folk.cutecritters.later: Give me a moment. I have not finished the last one.
folk.cutecritters.thanks.0: Oh, thank you! Take some fresh pastry!
folk.cutecritters.thanks.1: A cookie! Take some berries in return.
folk.cutecritters.thanks.2: Yay! Here, this is my treasure!
folk.cutecritters.thanks.3: ...(nods silently and hands you a candle)
folk.cutecritters.thanks.4: Thank you. Take some paper, you will need it.
folk.cutecritters.0.0: The cookies turned out well today!
folk.cutecritters.0.1: Come in for buns, it is always warm here.
folk.cutecritters.0.2: The Keeper? She is kind. She always asks us to stay.
folk.cutecritters.0.dark.0: Do you hear footsteps at night too?
folk.cutecritters.0.dark.1: The recipe used to be different. I cannot remember how.
folk.cutecritters.0.dark.2: Do not go far. It is dark out there, and so cosy in here.
folk.cutecritters.1.0: The flowers grow by themselves. I just stay out of their way.
folk.cutecritters.1.1: Have you seen the fox cub? He adores daisies.
folk.cutecritters.1.2: The whole town is one big garden.
folk.cutecritters.1.dark.0: The flowers always face one way. Toward you.
folk.cutecritters.1.dark.1: I planted something in the ground. It grew too fast.
folk.cutecritters.1.dark.2: They never wilt. Even when they should.
folk.cutecritters.2.0: Let us play! You are it!
folk.cutecritters.2.1: I have a secret! But I only tell it for a cookie.
folk.cutecritters.2.2: The tall lady reads me stories at night.
folk.cutecritters.2.dark.0: Auntie taught me not to turn around.
folk.cutecritters.2.dark.1: Can you see her too? Grown-ups usually cannot.
folk.cutecritters.2.dark.2: We are playing hide and seek. I cannot find Mum anymore.
folk.cutecritters.3.2: Do not trample the flowers on the graves.
folk.cutecritters.3.dark.0: The hole is ready. Do not worry, it is not for you. Yet.
folk.cutecritters.3.dark.1: The Keeper visited yesterday. Not me. The neighbour.
folk.cutecritters.3.dark.2: Do not look at me. She does not like it when I am looked at.
folk.cutecritters.4.1: Every book of the valley is here. Almost every one.
folk.cutecritters.4.2: The Recipe? There is no such book. Do not look for it.
folk.cutecritters.4.dark.0: She reads over your shoulder. Can you feel it?
folk.cutecritters.4.dark.1: One book left on its own. I heard footsteps.
folk.cutecritters.4.dark.2: The more you read, the closer she gets.
book.cutecritters.recipe.0:
THE RECIPE

Wheat.
Cocoa.
Sugar.
A pinch of warmth and a cup of kindness.
book.cutecritters.recipe.1:
Knead. Roll out.
Let it cool by the window.

Give it to the first one who is hungry.
Share until it runs out.
book.cutecritters.recipe.2:
The last ingredient must be given willingly.

Nobody can be forced.
Nobody can be kept by force.
book.cutecritters.recipe.3:
(written later, in different handwriting)

I forgot who I was baking for.
Someone, please remind me.
book.cutecritters.grotto.hint.0: One shelf in this room holds nothing. It stands only to cover something.
book.cutecritters.grotto.hint.1: Take it away, and you will hear the quiet beneath the floor.
book.cutecritters.grotto.deep.0: She hid here when she still remembered her own name.
book.cutecritters.grotto.deep.1: The deeper, the quieter. Quietest where nobody comes.
item.cutecritters.valley_key.tip: Fits the altar of the valley.
item.cutecritters.special_cookie.tip: It cannot be baked. It can only be accepted.
altar.cutecritters.keys.partial: The lock takes the key but stays silent. Keys you have: %s of %s.
altar.cutecritters.status.title: The altar of the valley
altar.cutecritters.status.hint: The keys hide where the valley keeps what it loves most: in a warm house, in a quiet room behind a shelf, in the deep under the water. The altar also listens to those who remember the recipe.
altar.cutecritters.secret.notEnough: She listens, but the words are not enough. Notes read: %s of %s.
altar.cutecritters.secret.noCookie: The recipe is not only to be read. Hold a cookie in the other hand: it is given to the first one who is hungry.
cookie.cutecritters.notHere: It smells like home. But it can only be eaten at the altar.
cookie.cutecritters.stranger: The cookie does not accept you. You are still too much of a stranger to the valley.
cookie.cutecritters.sure.1: If you eat this cookie, you will stay in the valley forever.
cookie.cutecritters.sure.2: You will never be alone again. And no one will be able to take you away.
cookie.cutecritters.sure.3: Click again within 30 seconds to stay.
cookie.cutecritters.feed.0: ARE YOU SURE? The cookie will go to %s.
cookie.cutecritters.feed.1: They will stay in the Keeper's place. Everyone else will leave free.
cookie.cutecritters.feed.2: Click again within 30 seconds to give the cookie.
cookie.cutecritters.found: There is a cookie in your pocket that you did not bake. It is still warm.
ending.cutecritters.escape.title: YOU LEFT
ending.cutecritters.escape.sub: The valley closed the door behind you.
ending.cutecritters.escape.text: You remember the way back. Sometimes your dreams smell like cookies.
ending.cutecritters.escape.broadcast: %s left the valley. The door closed behind them.
ending.cutecritters.break.title: THE RITUAL IS BROKEN
ending.cutecritters.break.sub: The altar is shattered. Silence is just silence again.
ending.cutecritters.break.text: Something huge exhaled and was gone. The animals look at you and no longer smile too wide.
ending.cutecritters.stay.title: YOU STAYED
ending.cutecritters.stay.sub: Now you will never be alone.
ending.cutecritters.stay.text: Warmth spreads through your whole body. Everyone around you is smiling. Everyone. Always. You like it.
ending.cutecritters.keeper.title: YOU ARE THE KEEPER NOW
ending.cutecritters.keeper.sub: The oven is warm. Guests will come. You are waiting for them.
ending.cutecritters.keeper.text: You remember a recipe you never knew. Your hands reach for the flour on their own.
ending.cutecritters.keeper.leash: The threads hold you. You cannot go further.
ending.cutecritters.keeper.free: The threads have loosened. You may go. But the cookies still smell like you.
ending.cutecritters.fed.title: SHE LET YOU GO
ending.cutecritters.fed.sub: But someone stayed in her place.
ending.cutecritters.fed.text: The valley went quiet. You leave without looking back. You will not look back.
ending.cutecritters.secret.title: SHE REMEMBERED
ending.cutecritters.secret.sub: Wheat. Cocoa. Sugar. And warmth given freely.
ending.cutecritters.secret.line.2: A pinch of warmth. A glass of kindness.
ending.cutecritters.secret.line.3: Give to the first who is hungry. Share until it is gone.
ending.cutecritters.secret.line.4: I did not bake so that you would stay. I baked so that you would not be cold.
ending.cutecritters.secret.line.5: Thank you. Go. I will not hold the door any more.
advancement.cutecritters.end_escape.desc: Ending: leave the valley with three keys.
advancement.cutecritters.end_break.title: Silence
advancement.cutecritters.end_break.desc: Ending: shatter the altar and break the ritual.
advancement.cutecritters.end_stay.title: Forever
advancement.cutecritters.end_stay.desc: Ending: eat the special cookie and stay.
advancement.cutecritters.end_fed.title: The Price of Freedom
advancement.cutecritters.end_fed.desc: Ending: leave, with a friend left in her place.
advancement.cutecritters.end_secret.desc: Secret ending: remind her why she baked.
